items.excerpt: Whispers of a Burning Scent (2026), directed by Mo Harawe, was filmed in Puntland State on of Somalia. When we first see the man at the center of the Somali Austrian filmmaker and screenwriter Mo Harawe’s short film “Whispers of a Burning Scent,” he is a background player. Practicing with the other members of a wedding band, he is one of several accompanists surrounding a lead singer, who is clad in colorful garments, swaying, and belting out lyrics. items.title: Six Somali Supreme Court judges sue federal government at East African Court of Justice
items.description: Mogadishu (HOL) — Six Somali Supreme Court judges, including disputed Chief Justice Baashe Yusuf Ahmed, have filed a case against the federal government at the East African Court of Justice (EACJ).
items.excerpt: Mogadishu (HOL) — Six Somali Supreme Court judges, including disputed Chief Justice Baashe Yusuf Ahmed, have filed a case against the federal government at the East African Court of Justice (EACJ).
